title: [134] Implement GPU/CPU indicator: sidebar footer + settings info panel
why_we_need_this: Owner approved mockups A (Sidebar Footer) and D (Settings Info Panel) from task 131. Users currently cannot tell whether transcription runs on GPU or CPU without checking logs. This adds a persistent glanceable signal in the sidebar and a detailed explanation in Settings, using the existing gpuBackend field from /api/health. Prepares the UI for the GPU/CPU choice feature in task 130.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Sidebar footer shows a slim strip at the bottom of the session list with GPU or CPU status, using the color priority schema: green fill for GPU, outline for CPU by choice, yellow fill for CPU fallback. Include a small icon (GPU chip or CPU chip) and a sublabel ("Idle" / "Transcribing…" / "GPU not available").
2. Settings modal gains a read-only info block in the Transcription section showing the current engine with a one-line plain-language explanation. Same color coding as sidebar footer. Uses left-border accent style per mockup D.
3. All states render correctly: GPU active, CPU by choice, CPU as automatic fallback (with distinct yellow coloring and a hint like "GPU is not available on this computer — transcription will take longer"), and running vs idle.
4. Both indicators read `gpuBackend` from the existing `/api/health` response — no new server fields or API changes needed. Thread `healthStatus.gpuBackend` to `SettingsModal` props.
5. Running state is derived from whether any session currently has status `transcribing`.
6. Plain language only — no backend method names, device IDs, Vulkan/CUDA/Metal names in the user UI. Both platforms show "GPU" or "CPU".
7. Follows the Necron brandbook: border-radius 0 on all elements, correct in both light and dark themes.
8. CPU fallback must NOT use red — yellow only (color priority schema).
important_constraints: No red for CPU fallback — yellow only per color priority schema. No diagnostics in user UI (no backend names, device IDs). Must work on both macOS and Windows — show "GPU" not "Metal"/"Vulkan"/"CUDA". Reference mockup artifact: https://claude.ai/artifact/66q1f5PqUqYH6hhNnKRoJG (options A and D). Related to task 130 (GPU/CPU installer choice) — do not duplicate its work.
